text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп is finished training for the
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, time for some suppletrain! The
grind never
ends!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Are you serious? You don't know what
suppletrain
is? What are you, stuck in
the Stone Age? Geez.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Supple as in "supplementary." Train as in

"training." Duh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It's trending all over the Golshi
multiverse, in case
you've been living
under a rock!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna be my trainer, you gotta
keep up
with what's going viral and
catch it like the
common cold, yo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: True, I can't fall behind the times.

text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna be my trainer, you gotta
keep up
with what's going viral and
catch it like the
common cold, yo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: True, I can't fall behind the times.

text_block_list.text:
I like your enthusiasm! With a mindset
like that,
there's a spot for you in the
Golshi multiverse yet!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And since you're so motivated to stay in
the
know, I'll give you a crash course on
all the
trends!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
"See dee"? Never heard of it. You sure
that's a
thing?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: In the Trainer multiverse, it is.

text_block_list.text: Huh. Well, what's it mean? Enlighten me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I tell Голд Шипп that "CD" stands for
"cool down,"
and she laughs.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of cooling down, though,
there's gotta
be a more efficient way to
do it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Like eating shaved ice while cooling
down! We
can call it "The Coolest Cool
Down"!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it'll be all the rage in the Golshi
multiverse!
I can just feel it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Come on! I'll show you what suppletrain
is all
about!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
One can only hope it stays in the Golshi

multiverse...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
